title: Senior Al Engineer
description:
**We're looking for a**
**Senior Al Engineer**
======================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Al Engineer – India**


**This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office**


Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a motivated AI Engineer to join our Workforce Intelligence team. You'll work on an AI\-powered assistant that helps managers and HR leaders understand their teams — surfacing skill gaps, career pathways, and organizational insights through natural\-language conversations backed by LLMs and real\-time analytics.
  

In this role, you'll build and ship features end\-to\-end across our backend and React/TypeScript frontend, working closely with data science, product, and platform engineering.


**In this role, you will…**


* Build and own backend features — design, implementation, testing, code review, and production monitoring.
* Work on our LLM integration layer: streaming AI responses, prompt engineering, structured output parsing, and response validation.
* Contribute to our RAG and semantic search architecture — hybrid vector search, caching strategies, and data ingestion pipelines.
* Build rich, interactive frontend experiences in React/TypeScript that render AI\-generated content in real time.
* Improve our NL\-to\-SQL pipeline that translates natural\-language questions into validated analytics queries.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and cross\-team collaborations.

**You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have…**  



* 3–5 years of experience building production backend services in any major language (Java, Python, Go, etc.).
* Working experience with TypeScript and React, or a strong willingness to work full\-stack.
* Solid understanding of REST API design, distributed systems, and service\-oriented architecture.
* Experience integrating LLMs into production systems — prompt design, streaming responses, or structured output handling.
* Experience with AWS services and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong engineering fundamentals: you care about test coverage, code review quality, and observable, maintainable systems.

**Extra dose of awesome if you have…**  



* Familiarity with vector databases or semantic search systems (Weaviate, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.).
* Experience with reactive or async programming patterns (WebFlux, SSE streaming, etc.).
* Exposure to analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, or similar).
* Familiarity with Redis for caching, session state, or pub/sub.
* Experience with monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo, etc.).
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or AI agent patterns

\#LI\-Onsite


**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.

title: Specialist Deputy Manager, Transformation and Optimization - Data Strategist - Hyderabad
description:
The incumbent will work with Enterprise Operations Xcellence Transformation and Optimization (ETO) team’s Data \& Analytics function, helping build and run a central data \& analytics platform that serves all EOX teams with trusted data, models, and reporting. The role frames problems, builds and runs scenario and trade\-off analyses, designs data models and reporting frameworks, and develops clear, well\-supported recommendations for stakeholders and leadership — while also stewarding the underlying data (architecture, cataloging, standards, and quality) so the platform remains a reliable, reusable asset rather than a one\-off deliverable.


This role is highly hands\-on, working directly with data and stakeholders to produce rigorous, credible analysis, and partners closely with the Data \& Analytics Associate Director on recommendations that inform cross\-functional decisions.


**Work you'll do**


As a Specialist Deputy Manager, Analytics and Insights on the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team, you will be responsible for:


* Framing ambiguous business problems into structured questions, hypotheses, and decision frameworks that can be analyzed and acted on.
* Building scenario, optimization, and trade\-off analyses; developing data models and reporting frameworks; and producing repeatable reporting for EOX teams.
* Partnering with data engineering to shape the architecture, pipelines, and structure of the central data and analytics platform.
* Governing data quality, cataloging, lineage, definitions, metric standards, and schema standards to support a consistent source of truth.
* Working with stakeholders and leaders across EOX process areas to prioritize analytics demand, build self\-service reporting solutions, and develop executive\-ready recommendations.

**The team**


Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) focuses on improving operational effectiveness, driving transformation execution, and enabling scalable, consistent, and high\-quality outcomes across the organization. The team works across process areas to strengthen governance, improve delivery discipline, and embed more efficient ways of working, including AI\-enabled support for reporting, risk visibility, action management, communications, training, and adoption.


**Location:** Hyderabad


**Shift Timings:** 2 PM to 11 PM


**Qualifications**


Required:


* Bachelor’s degree in business, data and analytics, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
* 8\+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, strategy, or another analytical role
* Experience building scenario models, optimization analyses, or trade\-off analyses for business decision\-making
* Experience designing data models and reporting frameworks for repeatable analysis and reporting
* Experience using SQL and Python for analysis
* Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks and version control tools such as Git

Preferred:


* Master’s degree in business, data and analytics, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
* Experience partnering with data engineering teams on data architecture and pipelines
* Experience with data cataloging or governance tools such as Unity Catalog, Purview, or Collibra
* Experience defining metric standards, schema standards, or key performance indicator governance
* Experience with AI\-enabled analytics tools such as natural\-language\-to\-SQL or generative AI\-assisted analysis
* Experience building self\-service dashboards, templates, or internal analytics products

title: Events Platform Manager
description:
**Job Title: Events Platform Manager**

* Location: Hyderabad


About Sanofi


We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R\&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.


Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches in our history. The Go\-to\-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people's lives.


About the Job


The Events Platform \- Manager role is a part of the Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM \& Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best\-in\-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision\-making process.


This role serves as the technical authority for Events and Congresses platform operations within OneCRM US, supporting the strategic vision for event platform capabilities, data governance, and system evolution. This leader ensures system enhancements operate as intended and advises on scalable event platform solutions that support multi\-brand, multi\-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise\-wide compliance, data integrity, and continuous platform transformation across all Promotional and Non\-Promotional event types (Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings etc.).


This position will work closely with CRM \& Enablers Team members in the US, US\-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Field Engagement Management, Business Operations, Compliance, other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to support the end\-to\-end design, governance, and evolution of the Events and Congresses platform across the OneCRM US ecosystem. This leader serves as a strategic partner across the enterprise, supporting platform direction, data governance standards, User Acceptance testing and operational frameworks that underpin compliant, high\-performing event execution at scale.


Main Responsibilities

* Support the strategic vision and roadmap for Events Management platform capabilities across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise Events \& Congress standards and business priorities
* Serve as the technical lead for Veeva Events and Congresses enhancement user acceptance testing and issue investigation/resolution, overseeing service ticket process and driving associated improvements to the process
* Identify and recommend scalable event platform solutions supporting multi\-brand Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings across multiple markets and business units
* Drive enterprise\-wide data discrepancy investigation and correction for Compliance and Transparency events data, establishing data quality standards and reconciliation frameworks for transparency, compliance, and data integrity across all event types and downstream systems
* Ensure accurate end\-to\-end event platform frameworks and processes — including topic management, speaker profiles, budgets, and nomination and content submission tools — that scale with organizational growth and platform evolution
* Mentor the events platform operations team, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and career development support that elevates individual and team capability
* Influence technical decisions across requirements gathering, system enhancements, and UAT for major platform initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and fit for enterprise purposes
* Contribute toshape of the long\-term roadmap for Events and Congresses platform evolution and integration with downstream systems, including iCare, transparency, FMV, GRF, and contracting
* Lead change management efforts for Service Ticket (ESM) enhancements and evolution, driving adoption and alignment across field teams, Field Engagement Management, and business stakeholders including the creation of knowledge based articles.
* Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through structured knowledge sharing, best practice development, and train\-the\-trainer programs
* Partner with Field Engagement Management, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Business Operations to influence event platform strategy and ensure the platform meets evolving business requirements
* Oversight of service/incident ticket process for events , establishing performance measurement frameworks and continuous improvement approaches that drive platform excellence
* Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring event platform strategies are integrated with broader CRM and Global Events and Congress initiatives and enterprise data standards
* Partner with internal and external vendor technical teams to ensure platform readiness


About our Team


The CRM \& Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM \& Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers — both brand teams and customer facing teams — to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems. This team operates as a strategic partner to the business, driving platform excellence and enabling compliant, high\-impact field engagement at enterprise scale.


About the Candidate


This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading technical teams, influencing enterprise platform strategy, and designing scalable event platform solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in Veeva Events and Congresses, data governance, and compliance requirements — including PhRMA guidelines and transparency reporting — combined with the ability to translate complex technical platform requirements into enterprise\-wide operational frameworks. This leader has experience architecting event management solutions, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Field Engagement Management, navigating complex matrix environments, and shaping platform strategy across concurrent launch programs. Strong English communication skills and availability to engage with US stakeholders with significant operational hour overlap are essential.


Ideal Experience

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four\-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred)
* 7\+ years of progressive events platform and CRM operations experience with demonstrated leadership
* 7\+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic platform initiatives across enterprise\-scale programs
* Experience in solution architecture for event management platforms and CRM systems
* Advanced expertise in data governance, compliance requirements (PhRMA guidelines), and data integrity across events and transparency reporting
* Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva Events and Congresses, Agile processes, and event management systems
* Deep understanding of the events ecosystem including transparency, FMV, GRF, contracting, and field engagement integration
* A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility
* Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others
* Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company's strategies and initiatives
* Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment
* Strong English communication skills with the ability to engage and align diverse stakeholders across geographies and functions

title: Senior Technical Lead (Product Releases & Engineering)
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**  

  

Company Name: Incepteo  

Industry: Information Technology \& Services  

Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level

Experience: 5\+ yrs



Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India



Job Type: Full\-time



Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering


**Role Purpose**
----------------



We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.



The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.



This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Release Management**
----------------------



You will coordinate releases across Development Test / QA UAT Production Monitoring.


* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies.


* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks.


* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes.


* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations.


* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution.



The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.


**Engineering Team Coordination**
---------------------------------


* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations.


* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early.


* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments.


* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification.



The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.


**Engineering Maturity \& Quality**
-----------------------------------



You will help strengthen:


* Pull\-request and code\-review discipline; Git branching, merge management, release branching and versioning.


* Definition of Done, release\-readiness criteria, automated build/test/deployment, code coverage and automated testing.


* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis.


* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices.



You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.


**Hands\-On Technical Capability**
----------------------------------



Although release and team coordination are the main focus, this remains a hands\-on technical leadership role. You should be comfortable working across React / React.js, Python, REST APIs and backend services, MySQL or similar relational databases, Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions / CI/CD, Google Cloud Platform, authentication and authorisation, SaaS integrations, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.

  



Strong, practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and GitHub is vital for this role. You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.



You should be capable of reviewing code, challenging implementation decisions and stepping into complex technical or production issues when necessary.

  



Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.


**Production \& Incident Management**
-------------------------------------


* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes.


* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes.


* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed.



We are looking for someone who remains calm, methodical and accountable under pressure.


**Experience We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------



Ideally, you will have 5\+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful technical leadership responsibility in a production SaaS environment, including:


* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments.


* Google Cloud deployment, operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.


* GitHub repository, branch, pull\-request and permissions management, including GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation.


* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices.


* Production incident resolution, cross\-functional working with Product Owners, architects and delivery managers, and continuous engineering process improvement.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have personally owned these responsibilities, rather than simply participated within a team where others managed releases and coordination.


**Leadership Maturity**
-----------------------


* Ownership – takes responsibility and drives outcomes.


* Judgement – knows when to proceed, challenge or escalate.


* Organisation – keeps multiple developers and dependencies coordinated.


* Communication – explains technical issues clearly.


* Composure – remains effective during releases and incidents.

description:
We are looking for an experienced **AI Product Manager** who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high\-ownership, enterprise\-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting\-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products.


The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.


The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption.
* Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape AI\-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision\-support tools, and human\-in\-the\-loop enterprise applications.
* Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product artifacts such as problem statements, user journeys, PRDs, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and release scope.
* Partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and delivery teams to ensure product intent is translated into practical, scalable solutions.
* Drive workshops, requirement discovery sessions, stakeholder reviews, demos, and alignment discussions with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
* Build lightweight prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and product mock flows using modern AI tools, no\-code/low\-code methods, vibe coding, and basic design/prototyping techniques where useful.
* Help define and refine AI use cases involving agents, orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, and enterprise system integration.
* Maintain a sharp eye for detail across business requirements, product behavior, user experience, and delivery quality.
* Manage client expectations proactively by balancing ambition, technical feasibility, timelines, and delivery realities.
* Support value realization and account growth by identifying follow\-on product opportunities, expansion areas, and innovation pathways within client accounts.
* Contribute to a product and delivery culture that values speed, clarity, experimentation, accountability, and customer impact.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Enterprise AI products and features are clearly defined, well\-prioritized, and shipped with strong adoption potential.
* Clients see you as a credible product partner who understands both business value and execution constraints.
* Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams.
* AI use cases move beyond demos into usable workflows that solve real operational problems.
* Teams make faster, better decisions because product direction, scope, and trade\-offs are well managed.
* Client confidence improves through strong communication, attention to detail, and disciplined expectation management.
* You help create momentum for account expansion by spotting practical product and AI opportunities that clients want to invest in.

  

**Requirements**  

* + 7–14 years of experience in ProApplication formDesign the application form for this role.duct Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Enterprise Software, Digital Products, or related technology roles.
	+ Demonstrated experience working on software products, platforms, or enterprise applications in client\-facing environments.
	+ Good understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, with practical exposure to AI\-enabled product design and delivery.
	+ Exposure to building or shaping **agent\-based / agentic workflows** or AI\-driven assistants/copilots in a product or solution context.
	+ Strong experience in requirements discovery, user story definition, prioritization, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional execution.
	+ Ability to engage confidently with enterprise clients, business users, engineering teams, and senior internal stakeholders.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and present with clarity.
	+ High attention to detail and the ability to manage product quality and client expectations in parallel.
	+ A hands\-on mindset with the willingness to prototype, experiment, and validate ideas quickly rather than rely only on documentation.
	+ Comfort working in ambiguous, fast\-evolving environments where AI capabilities, client needs, and product direction are still being shaped.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Prior experience in a consulting or client advisory environment is highly desirable.
	+ Exposure to enterprise domains and business applications is preferred.
	+ Experience supporting **farming\-led account expansion**, identifying opportunities within existing accounts, or helping grow strategic client relationships is a strong plus.
	+ Background as a Software Engineer or strong technical foundation is preferred.
	+ Familiarity with enterprise workflow systems, platform integrations, business process automation, or complex multi\-stakeholder applications is a plus.
	+ Experience creating basic prototypes independently using AI coding tools, prompt\-based development, wireframing, or lightweight design tools.
	+ Strong educational background from top\-tier institutions is preferred, including **IIMs**, **IITs, BIT Mesra, BITS Pilani, top NITs,** or equivalent institutions.

**Skills and Capability Areas**

* + AI product thinking and practical GenAI application
	+ Agentic workflow understanding and AI feature conceptualization
	+ Enterprise product management and requirements rigor
	+ Client\-facing communication and consulting maturity
	+ Hands\-on prototyping, experimentation, and validation
	+ Cross\-functional collaboration with engineering, UX, and delivery
	+ Strong execution discipline and attention to detail
	+ Commercial awareness and account growth mindset

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* + You are likely to thrive in this role if you are someone who enjoys building in fast\-moving environments, likes solving messy enterprise problems, and can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You are structured but not rigid, hands\-on but not narrow, and client\-focused without losing product depth. You bring ownership, curiosity, and pragmatism. You know how to earn trust in a room, ask the right questions, and turn ambiguity into action.
	+ You should also enjoy working at the frontier of enterprise AI, where the best solutions require not only product thinking and technical awareness, but also judgment, experimentation, and strong partnership with clients and delivery teams.

**Why Join Accellor**


This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping real enterprise AI products, not just internal experiments or slideware. At Accellor, you will work on cutting\-edge AI applications for global clients, solve complex business problems, and build products that matter in real operating environments.

* You will gain exposure to international clients, cross\-functional teams, and high\-impact business contexts. You will have the opportunity to influence both product direction and delivery outcomes, while building deep experience in one of the most important technology shifts underway today.
* For the right candidate, this role offers a strong platform for growth across AI product management, enterprise transformation, consulting, and global client leadership.

**Location / Working Model**


This role is based in **Hyderabad or Bangalore**. Travel may be required based on client and project needs.

**Reporting Structure**

**About the Role**  

  

  

The **Product Costing \& Inventory Valuation Manager** leads costing, inventory valuation, and month\-end/year\-end closing activities. The role manages the team, ensures compliance and accuracy, partners with stakeholders, and drives process improvements, digitalization, and operational excellence.


**What's In It for You**  

  

* Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative
* Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways
* Access to BASF's world\-class learning \& development programs
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture
* Hybrid work model (mix of on\-site and remote)

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Understand stakeholder needs and provide **relevant, timely, and solution\-oriented support**.
* Develop a strong **end\-to\-end process understanding** and leverage it to deliver value to business partners.
* Ensure the team delivers **compliant, efficient, and high\-quality services** by establishing and maintaining technical standards.
* Collaborate with **Book\-to\-Report teams across regions** on operational activities and projects.
* Act as a **business partner to BASF internal stakeholders**, identifying, evaluating, and implementing effective solutions.

**Team Management**


* Provide **disciplinary leadership**, including work allocation, goal setting, performance evaluation, feedback, and decision\-making.
* Develop team members by identifying **strengths, development needs, and career opportunities**, and implementing appropriate development plans.
* Foster an **open, collaborative, and inclusive team environment** with strong communication.
* Mentor Senior Analysts and Analysts, promoting **quality, best practices, and team collaboration**.
* Drive **team engagement, motivation, and morale** while supporting employee development.
* Act as a **backup to the Director** and undertake additional responsibilities as required.

**Project Management**


* Lead and support **process improvement and optimization projects**, leveraging digital technologies to enhance efficiency and value creation.
* Monitor **SLAs, Balanced Scorecards, and KPIs** to ensure continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Ensure stakeholder queries and **ad\-hoc requests** are addressed proactively and within agreed timelines.
* Understand business requirements and work closely with stakeholders to deliver **customized, high\-quality solutions** in line with SLAs.

**Resource Management**


* Allocate **resources and responsibilities** effectively to ensure high\-quality and compliant service delivery.
* Manage recruitment activities within the approved **budget and workforce requirements**.
* Identify employee strengths and development needs and support their **professional and career development**.
* Conduct regular **team meetings and individual reviews** to identify and address issues effectively.
* Manage and monitor the **FTE budget** for the team.

**Knowledge Management**


* Ensure **proper documentation and accessibility of process knowledge**.
* Facilitate effective **knowledge sharing and transfer** to build sustainable capabilities within the team.

**Operational Activities**


* Ensure timely and accurate **month\-end and year\-end closing and reporting** in line with BASF guidelines and work instructions.
* Oversee activities related to **Product Costing \& Inventory Valuation, Project Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profitability Analysis, Non\-Trade Transactions, and Reporting/BI Solutions**.
* Provide guidance on **inventory valuation** and support the team during month\-end closing activities.
* Review **actual vs. standard cost and production order variance analysis** prepared by the team.
* Review and oversee the **Annual Operating Plan**, including fixed production costs and variable cost rates.
* Review **inventory valuation adjustments and inventory provision calculations**, including provisions for slow\-moving inventory, NRV, and replacement price.
* Ensure timely communication with stakeholders regarding **progress, issues, and resolutions**.
* Drive **continuous improvement, automation, and adoption of new technologies and systems** to enhance operational effectiveness.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance / CA / CMA
* 10 \- 18 years of progressive experience in Accounting, Controlling, Costing, Financial Reporting or Shared Services environments.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management and people management experience.
* Prior experience of Leading a team of 10 employees.
* Excellent analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in MNC and Captive GCC experience is preferred

**Technical Skills**  

  

* Advanced knowledge in standard Microsoft Office software (word, excel, power point).
* Proficiency in English required with good communication in verbal, writing and interpersonal skills with high customer focus. Proficiency in other languages is a plus.
* Knowledge of SAP system is mandatory.

title: Product Manager - Tax New
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.


Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.


Arcesium is looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.



We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.



The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands\-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.


**What You'll Do:**

  

* **Own the product**: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* **Go deep on the technical detail**: Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K\-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48\) into precise specifications.
* **Engage clients directly**: Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* **Support the roadmap**: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* **Grow with the role**: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.


**What You'll Need:**


* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands\-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K\-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48\.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high\-tech software development environment.


Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

  

**Recruiting Security**  

Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).


*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*
